resolution.note: krn-handoff prompt runs the injected Verify; successor-launch refuses a prompt naming a handoff read

title: Stop the successor prompt from re-reading the injected handoff
body:
Outcome: a successor session starts from the SessionStart handoff injection without reading handoff.md again; the krn-handoff successor prompt tells it to run the injected Verify command instead of "Read <handoff path>".
Why: 181 of 221 lead sessions since 2026-11-01 (81%) received the handoff from the SessionStart hook and still read handoff.md (1.46M result chars, ~2k tokens per session carried through every later turn): .krn/runs/roadmap-refill/startup-and-subagents.md. The prompt text sits in .agents/skills/krn-handoff/SKILL.md (successor-launch --prompt).
Proof: the successor prompt names no handoff read; a rerun of .krn/runs/roadmap-refill/startup-and-subagents.py on later sessions shows the re-read share falling.
Scope: this repository.
